topic: Updated data aggregation scripts and guidance
summary_markdown: The user provided an update regarding room membership and shared critical information about deprecated data sources. Specifically, the `device_session_agg_4` source is no longer reliable. To prevent data loss, updated scripts were distributed for two key processes: 1. Aggregating Machine Learning (ML) data to staging. 2. Copying data from staging to production.
decisions: Updated scripts must be used for ML-to-staging and stage-to-prod aggregation.
action_items: Users should utilize the provided GitHub links for updated data processing scripts.
